description: This file contains shell functions related to verifying firmware signatures and metadata during the upgrade process, specifically 'fwtool_check_signature' and 'fwtool_check_image'. It interacts with external tools such as 'fwtool', 'ucert', and uses JSON parsing functions, indicating it manages firmware validation steps in a Linux/OpenWrt environment.

methods.name: fwtool_check_signature
methods.description: Checks the digital signature of the firmware image using 'fwtool' and 'ucert', ensures signature presence if required.

methods.name: fwtool_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image metadata and compatibility, including device support, version compatibility, and optional configuration checks.
